name: smwgraphics-cave-story-laboratory
title: Cave Story - Laboratory
description:
A rip of the GFX from the little "laboratory" scene that plays during the ending credits of Cave Story. For a set that is generally seen for no more than about 5 seconds, it's not half bad.

My rule of thumb is that, while I'd be happy if you gave credit, I won't force you to do so.
